## Why visit

A long-established continental beer bar with enough changing cask to make it relevant even for visitors who have already explored Belgium and Germany extensively. The eccentric decor and informal format distinguish it from the more polished beer cafés. Its strongest role is as part of the Swan Street circuit: stop for a local or regional cask, inspect the continental list, and see whether a cider deserves attention. The combination gives the visit a different flavour from the nearby brewery-run Smithfield.

## Beer

CAMRA documents five changing cask ales alongside continental draught and bottled beer.

## Food

Traditional packaged bar snacks; the operator says there is no full kitchen.

## Plan the visit

Walk-ins rather than table bookings. Beer and atmosphere are the reasons to visit; eat elsewhere for a full meal.

**Getting there:** Walk from Shudehill; very close to Smithfield Market Tavern and Crown & Kettle.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
